title: fix(plugin-list): an ungrouped list asks for the declared nameField
body:
Fixes #13116
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

An ungrouped list view fetches its rows through `plugin-list` `ListView`. Its `$select` harvest (`addSpeculative`) had arms for view bindings, grouping, `rowColor`, `settledWhen` and `referenceVia`, but none for the object's declared `nameField`. So when no column showed that field, the rows arrived without it, and the bulk confirm step (`BulkActionDialog`, objectui#13107) fell to the `Record #ID` floor.

This adds one arm, `addSpeculative(declaredNameField(objectDef))`, beside the `referenceVia` arm. `declaredNameField` is the same `@object-ui/core` helper `ObjectGrid` `getSelectFields` uses for this field (PR #13112), and plugin-list already imports `@object-ui/core`. The arm goes through the gates every other arm uses: the known-field gate (the object must declare it) and the FLS gate (the viewer may read it). It is fetched, not drawn: it joins the projection, not the columns. `required` is a set, so a `nameField` that is already a column is sent once. Nothing else moves; no export, prop or type member is added.

## Pins (`packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.nameFieldSelect-13116.test.tsx`)

The data source honours `$select` the way a server does: a row carries the selected keys only. plugin-list does not depend on plugin-grid, so a stub grid stands in, and the confirm step's name is asked of the rule that step applies (`recordDisplayValueAt(row, declaredNameField(def))`, then `getRecordDisplayName`) against the rows the grid is handed. The real dialog is pinned on plugin-grid's side by `bulkConfirmNameField-13107.test.tsx`.

- (a) Formula `full_name` as `nameField`, columns `first_name` / `last_name` / `title`: the `$select` carries `full_name`, no grid column is drawn for it, and the rows name `John Smith` and `Marcus Reed`.
- CONTROL (b): an object with no `nameField` sends the same `$select` as before (`body`, `id`, `subject`).
- CONTROL (b): a `nameField` that is a column is sent once.

## Ablation (one-off, via objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; no permanent test)

Dropped the arm (anchor `addSpeculative(declaredNameField(objectDef));`, count 1 to 0). Blob `ecffd5bc77e4` became `978e1d188f1f`. Pin (a) went red: `expected [ 'first_name', 'id', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'first_name', 'full_name', …(3) ]`; the two controls stayed green (1 failed, 2 passed). Restored: blob equals HEAD (`ecffd5bc77e4`), `git diff HEAD` empty, anchor count back to 1.
